help.departureAirport: Select the departure airport. You can search by IATA code (e.g. FRA) or name.
help.arrivalAirport: Select the destination airport. You can search by IATA code (e.g. LHR) or name.

help.tags: Add tags to categorize and filter flights later (e.g. 'business', 'international').
help.tagsExpanded: Enter or a comma turns the text into a tag; your earlier tags are suggested as you type. You can filter by tags later and group statistics by tags. Examples: 'business', 'vacation', 'lufthansa', 'long-haul'.
help.flightNumber: Enter the flight number (e.g. LH400). Automatic search works for today's flights. For past or future flights an Aviationstack Basic+ key is required — otherwise please enter the flight manually.
help.flightNumberExpanded:
The flight lookup cascades through multiple APIs:
• Aviationstack (with Basic+ key: past and future flights)
• AirLabs (today's flights)
• OpenSky (today's flights, credentials required)

If no provider covers the selected date, you'll need to enter the flight manually. Even with a key configured, the API may simply not have data for some flights.

regexWarning.title: Automatic import is still limited
regexWarning.body:
Without a local LLM (Ollama), a rule-based importer is used. It currently supports only a few airlines and can't yet handle emails with multiple flights. We're actively working on improvements.

Recommendation: configure an Ollama endpoint (e.g. gemma3:12b) under Admin → Parser, or enter flights manually.

bookingPrice.noTotal: No total is recorded for this booking. Totals therefore count each flight with its own price plus taxes and fees; a flight with no price at all counts as unknown, not as 0.
